subject.title: WhatsApp inter_session delivery requests can be wrongly suppressed as REPLY_SKIP / ANNOUNCE_SKIP / NO_REPLY

question: Should this WhatsApp inter_session delivery bug be fixed now as a narrow sessions_send prompt/runtime source-reply repair, or folded into the broader structured A2A handoff contract?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the permanent fix changes model-facing A2A delivery semantics and overlaps both the open requester-return-path PR and broader structured handoff work.

options.title: Narrow and land requester-return fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97311 or a replacement as the focused fix after addressing its prompt-cache and sensitive-identifier review blockers.

options.title: Fold into structured handoff design
options.body: Keep this issue open as acceptance coverage for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/33478 and require the typed handoff design to cover explicit delivery intent.

options.title: Keep current behavior pending live repro
options.body: Require a fresh WhatsApp live reproduction before changing A2A delivery semantics, accepting that the source-level suppression path remains open.

recommendation.title: Narrow and land requester-return fix
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97311 or a replacement as the focused fix after addressing its prompt-cache and sensitive-identifier review blockers.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available routing signal from current blame plus broader structured handoff triage.
